messages:
Rae: Quick FYI — bringing cerulean-v2 (fp16 -> q6) up on staging. Early smoke shows spacing/punctuation anomalies when outputs mix CJK and Arabic spans.
Min: Can you drop an example and quick metrics?
Rae: Short repro below. fp16 reference vs q6 canary:
```
INPUT: "今日は السلام arrived at the gate."
FP16: "今日は السلام arrived at the gate."
Q6: "今日はالسلام arrived at the gate."  <-- missing separator between CJK and Arabic
```
Omar: Token ID diff for that sample?
Rae: Token boundaries look identical for this sample. Ran a 5k mixed-orient smoke subset: zh->ar BLEU delta -1.1, and our "separator-rate" metric (fraction of CJK->RTL adjacency with a whitespace or ZWNJ) fell from 0.987 -> 0.908 on q6.
Jia: Oof. That metric drop is significant. Any detok / profile loader errors in logs?
Rae: Logs show profile loaded, but then a warning when fast-path enabled: 
```
2026-04-01T09:11:02Z cerulean-init: tokenizer v3 ok
2026-04-01T09:11:02Z quant-kernel: q6 ready
2026-04-01T09:11:02Z detok: profile '/etc/redwood/locale_profiles.json' loaded
2026-04-01T09:11:02Z detok: fast-path enabled (FLAG_DETOK_FAST=1)
2026-04-01T09:11:02Z detok: fast-path invariant failed for sample id 4231 -> using simple-join fallback
```
Min: So the profile exists, but the fast-path falls back at runtime for some inputs. Perhaps the fast code has a bug for mixed-script bidi adjacency.
Omar: We saw similar behavior on another model where the fast-path skipped the CJK-RTL separator check due to a truncated lookup table after quant init. Could be memory layout changes in q6 kernels.
Jia: Actionable plan: 1) disable FLAG_DETOK_FAST in q6 canary until we fix the fast routine; 2) add a pre-rollout detok smoke (1k mixed-orient samples) that asserts separator-rate within 98% of fp16 baseline; 3) add a unit test covering Han->Arabic adjacency to exercise fast-path edge cases.
Rae: I'll open PR to flip the flag and include the smoke in the bringup checklist. @Omar can you reproduce a minimal failing unit test for the fast-path?
Omar: Will do. Also adding a CI gate: infra, queue detok-smoke/cerulean-q6 with samples=1000.
ci-bot: Job queued: ci/detok_smoke/cerulean-q6-2026-04-01 #2407. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/2407 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Min: Good. If the fix is small we can continue canary but pause wider rollout until smoke passes. Make sure to attach failing sample ids to the ticket.
Rae: Filed ML ticket ML-3999 with sample ids and diffs. Will post CI outcome when available. :thumbsup:
